title: The Stars with Rhonda: Your Bloodwork Knows
description: Rhonda reads cosmic health predictions as serene fact while Ronnie spirals into hypochondria. Your bloodwork already came back, and it keeps arriving sooner.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And now, the stars, with Rhonda. Rhonda, how's everybody's health looking?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Aries. A single sit-up will undo decades of structural denial. Your knee has filed a complaint. <p:0.3> And your bloodwork already came back.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Came back? I didn't... when did anyone draw blood?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Taurus. You will say I feel fine out loud, and the universe will write it down to use against you.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Okay, note to self, never feel fine.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Gemini. The left side of your body and the right side are no longer on speaking terms. Choose a side. <p:0.3> Your bloodwork came back early.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Early? How is it getting faster?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Virgo. That twinge is not nothing. It was never nothing. The lab called before you booked the appointment.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I have a twinge. Right now. Rhonda, I have the twinge.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Scorpio. Your bloodwork came back before the blood. It came back before YOU. <p:0.3> The results are in the casserole. Do not eat the casserole.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's my sign. That's MY sign. So... what do I do?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Great. Cosmic. <p:0.3> We'll be right back, assuming my left side agrees.
